# Vane

> Vane is a personalized weather app for iPhone that learns how different weather conditions feel to an individual and adds that personal context to a full weather forecast.

Vane's personalization system is called Sense. It learns from simple weather check-ins over time while Vane continues to provide standard forecast details such as temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, UV, sunrise, and sunset. Vane is currently available as a free public iPhone beta through TestFlight.

## Product and beta

- [Vane home](https://vane.codearc.studio/): Official Vane website with an overview of the product, Sense, privacy, and the public beta.
- [Join the Vane beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/GHEW2GvN): Official TestFlight invitation for the free public iPhone beta.
